note: Gold pages verified by grepping the parsed corpus, not recalled from memory. 'pages' lists every page where the answer is genuinely present; a retrieval counts as a hit if any listed page appears in the returned set. Cases marked unanswerable have no supporting page and exist to test abstention rather than recall. Each answerable case also carries `answer_contains`: a distinctive substring of the actual answer, verified to occur in the parsed corpus on its gold page. This enables context recall -- whether the text returned to the model actually contains the answer -- which ranking metrics cannot measure.
